brand.name: Latch
brand.tagline: Check the terms. Keep the decision yours.
home.heading: Make sure the whole kit is in the quote.
home.body: Review supplier offers, check what is included, and approve the terms you actually saw. Latch checks them again before you release the request.
empty.heading: A little breathing room.
empty.body: Nothing waiting on you. Enjoy the quiet.
request.name: Request name
review.heading: Check the terms that matter.
review.none: The required terms have been checked.
approval.scope: This approves an internal purchase request. It does not place an order.
approval.expired: This approval has expired. Review the current terms before continuing.
release.changed: The terms changed while you were away.
release.changedBody: Your earlier approval stays in the history. Review the changes before approving this version.
release.failed: We could not check this source. Your approval is still on hold.
release.boundary: This record reflects captured supplier terms. It does not reserve stock or guarantee a price.
error.network: The connection dropped. Your saved work is still here.
error.source: This page is not supported yet. Choose a supported supplier page.
error.session: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.conflict: This request changed in another tab. Load the latest version before continuing.
error.generic: That did not go through. Try again, or use the reference below when asking for help.
theme.label: Appearance
auth.heading: Welcome to Latch.
auth.body: Sign in to keep your requests and decisions together.
auth.provision: Your operator can create an account for you.
request.heading: Put the whole request on paper.
request.intro: Start with what you need, when you need it, and the amount you can spend.
request.publicHelp: Only this specification will be sent for source inspection. Keep private notes in the required specification.
request.deadlineHelp: Enter local time in the timezone shown. Use an IANA name such as Africa/Lagos.
request.budgetHelp: USD, with up to two decimal places.
request.noProfiles: No supplier pages have been admitted yet. You can save the items and add suppliers later.
request.savedHelp: This version is stored. You can return to it later.
request.historyHelp: Earlier versions stay in the history when you save a change.
request.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
request.archivedHelp: This request is archived. Its saved versions remain available.
request.inspectPending: Offer inspection will be available after the source and worker checks are complete. Your draft is ready to keep.
request.futureBody: When inspection is available, each supplier offer will be checked against this worksheet. You will review the source terms before approving a decision.
list.heading: Your requests.
list.intro: A place for the details, and a clear record of what you saved.
settings.heading: Make yourself at home.
settings.stale: Confirm your identity before approving a decision.
status.heading: Service availability
status.worker: Offer inspection is awaiting source and worker validation.
error.login: The username or password did not match.
error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
error.deadline: Choose a deadline in the future.
error.origin: This request could not be verified. Refresh the page and try again.
error.idempotency: This save does not match an earlier attempt. Refresh before trying again.
error.database: Saved requests are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
error.worker: Offer inspection is not available yet. Your saved request is still here.
error.archived: This request is archived. Its saved history is still available.
error.notFound: We could not find that request.
error.format: This request format is not supported.
error.timezone: The deadline and timezone do not match. Choose an unambiguous local time and a valid IANA timezone.
home.draftBody: Put the items, quantities, budget and deadline in one saved worksheet. Keep each revision available when the details change.
home.workflow: Sign in, write what you need, and save a draft. Return to it from any tab, revise it, or open an earlier saved version.
home.pending: Supplier inspection, source review and purchase release are awaiting source and worker validation.
request.profileUnavailable: This supplier profile is no longer available
review.intro: Check each value against the captured supplier page. Missing terms remain unresolved.
review.empty: No captured evidence for this version.
review.emptyBody: Your saved worksheet is available. Source review begins when an inspection has stored evidence.
review.noExtraction: This capture has no extracted terms yet. You can read the saved source.
review.reason.source_absent: The captured source does not state this term.
review.reason.unreadable: This term could not be read.
review.reason.unsupported_basis: The quantity or price basis is unresolved.
review.reason.conflicting_values: The captured source states competing values.
review.imageHelp: The screenshot keeps its original colors. Text is available without downloading the image.
review.imageUnavailable: The screenshot could not be loaded. Read the captured text or try again.
review.imageAlt: Sanitized screenshot of the captured supplier page
review.noQuotes: No original supporting quote was captured for this term.
review.quoteHelp: Copy an exact, unique passage from the captured text. Use up to four references.
review.quoteInvalid: Each reference must match one unique passage on its selected captured page.
review.moneyHelp: USD, with up to two decimal places. The amount must appear in the captured quote.
review.integerHelp: Enter a whole number of units.
review.arrivalHelp: Enter an ISO date and time with an explicit timezone.
review.acknowledge: I viewed the captured evidence for this term.
review.confirmHelp: Checking uses the supported original value and its original captured quotes.
review.disputeHelp: Marking unclear removes the usable value. The original extraction and history stay available.
review.blocked: This source packet is not available for new decisions. The request, source or inspection may have changed.
review.conflict: The review or request changed. Load the latest state before making another decision.
review.valueInvalid: Enter a value in the format shown.
review.reasonInvalid: Enter a reason with at least three characters.
review.acknowledgeInvalid: Acknowledge viewing this field evidence before saving.
review.noApproval: Approval and purchase release are not available yet.
review.basketAbsent: No purchase total can be calculated from this packet.
review.basketIncomplete: Required quantities or purchase terms are unresolved.
review.basketUnfit: The current terms do not fit this request.
review.basketFits: The calculated terms fit this request.
review.attribution: Decisions record the signed in requester and the captured source. A check does not guarantee the supplier claim.
review.blocker.packet_changed: This source packet is not available for new decisions. The request, source or inspection may have changed.
review.blocker.inspection_active: A source inspection is in progress. New decisions are on hold until it finishes.
review.blocker.profile_unavailable: This supplier profile is unavailable or expired. The captured evidence remains readable.
review.choiceHelp: Choose the value supported by the captured source.
